answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Sponsor bonds: a newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with 33 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 33 POA on a stranger. A bought sponsor costs more than the fake's first epoch of emission. A summit of doubt is healthy, a plume of proof is required, and a copper of patience is the price of a clean panel. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
